summary: Implemented the deprecated decorators feature. Added monai/utils/deprecate_utils.py with deprecated (functions and classes), deprecated_arg (per-argument, checked only when supplied), and DeprecatedError; exported them from monai/utils/__init__.py; added tests/test_deprecated.py. All 7 new tests pass under the shared generator-venv Python. Caveats: the environment's MONAI version is "0+unknown" so the default version_val never triggers warnings, and the tests pin version_val explicitly. Docs and the broader suite were not run (test_utils.py and test_module_list.py reported no tests collected). Nothing was committed.
